personality_one_liner: Raw, exposed structural utility designed for testing failure states aggressively.

dont's: Absolutely no blur or glass. Everything is raw, flat, and hard-edged.

screens.name: ModeSelection
screens.purpose: Select between Good or Broken app experience.

states.loading: Raw spinner centered on stark white.

screens.layout: Split-screen vertically. Top half GOOD mode (green accent, perfect geometric abstract image), Bottom half BROKEN mode (red accent, chaotic abstract image). Massive uppercase typography. Hard 2pt border separating sections.

screens.name: BugPickerDashboard
screens.purpose: Toggle specific bugs to activate in the Broken version.
screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list of toggles. Each row has a hard 2pt bottom border (`borderStrong`). Large typography for bug name, monospace for description. Square brutalist toggle switches. Sticky CTA 'START DEMO' at bottom.

screens.name: DemoLogin
screens.purpose: Simple form to demonstrate 'broken form checks' bug.

states.error: Error messages appear aggressively below inputs.

screens.layout: Labels above inputs. Inputs have `borderStrong` 2pt border, square corners. Massive solid black 'LOGIN' button at the bottom.

screens.name: DemoNotesList
screens.purpose: List of notes and tasks to demonstrate 'slow/laggy' and 'misbehaving buttons' bugs.

states.empty: Raw vector icon, monospace 'NO NOTES FOUND'.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list. Each note is a row separated by 2pt `borderStrong`. Checkboxes are raw hard squares. Floating '+ NEW NOTE' button (square FAB).

screens.name: DemoNoteEditor
screens.purpose: Write note to demonstrate 'rotation loses typed data' and 'save crash' bugs.
screens.layout: Full bleed text area without visible input border (just screen padding). Sticky massive 'SAVE' button at bottom. Floating mode badge sits absolute at top right.

good_mode_hero.alt: Perfectly organized geometric shapes representing good mode

bad_mode_hero.alt: Chaotic broken geometric shapes representing bad mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply 5 Brutalist Mobile personality. Zero border radius anywhere.
Hard 2pt black borders (`borderStrong`) for structural separation, inputs, and layout frames.
Use Space Grotesk for display and JetBrains Mono for body/labels.

Implement the 5 bugs purely in logic/state: broken form checks (don't validate email/password), misbehaving buttons (e.g., save tap saves twice or does nothing randomly), app crashes (throw unhandled exception), rotation loses typed data (clear state on mount/unmount simulating rotation remount), slow and battery-heavy (synchronous heavy loops causing lag).
No explanatory UI about the bugs in the demo app. Only the dashboard describes them.
Floating mode badge: A hard-edged floating square `borderStrong` bordered pill that returns user to Dashboard. Must be visible in the demo app.
Implement the Sticky CTA pattern exactly: `position: fixed` equivalent (View pinned to bottom), outside ScrollView.
Images for Good/Bad modes must have a gradient-to-dark scrim if text is overlaid.
